title: First iPhone announced (2007)
description: Steve Jobs unveiled the iPhone, reshaping mobile computing — and accelerating Linux-based Android as the open counterpart.

title: Mozilla milestone
description: The Mozilla project, born from Netscape's open-sourcing in 1998, gave the world Firefox and a renewed open Web.

title: Pi Day and Free Software
description: A day to celebrate math — and the free software that computes it. Many GNU tools were first packaged on early Linux distributions in March.

title: Kubernetes 1.0 era
description: May has seen multiple KubeCon EU editions shaping the cloud native ecosystem around open standards.

title: openSUSE community day
description: openSUSE contributors around the world gather in June to coordinate releases of Leap and Tumbleweed.

title: Linus posts about Linux (1991)
description: Linus Torvalds posts to comp.os.minix announcing his free operating system project — the birth of Linux.

title: GNU Project announced (1983)
description: Richard Stallman announces the GNU Project, the foundation of the free software movement.

title: SUSE founding month (1992)
description: SUSE was founded in Germany in 1992, becoming the oldest existing commercial Linux company.

title: Open source winter releases
description: Many maintainers tag year-end releases — a gift of code to the community.
